description: Search Sage's free color-by-number math printables for ages 4-8 (grades K-2). Newest first when browsing, most relevant first with a query. Each result has an id for get_printable, a pageUrl to print or download from, and imageUrl, the worksheet PNG. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for more.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, for the next page.

date.description: Only the sheet(s) for this publish date, YYYY-MM-DD.

query.description: Words to look for in the title, topic, tags, historical event and description, like 'moon landing' or 'saints'. Omit to browse.

tag.description: Only sheets with this topic tag: moments-in-history (Moments in History), inventions-and-discoveries (Inventions & Discoveries), faith (Faith), art (Art), natural-science (Natural Science), holidays-and-traditions (Holidays & Traditions).

today.description: Only today's sheet(s), by the date in New York.

name: search_printables
title: Search printables
